scope.title: Core AI Service Architecture & Context Recognition
scope.description: Fix TDEE over-emphasis and implement smart context analysis

critical-issues.issue: TDEE data forced in buildUserProfile() at lines 399-425 in aiCoaching.ts
Line 506 forces "based on their TDEE data" for all responses
No context recognition to determine query relevance

task.details: - Implement QueryAnalysis interface - Build relevance scoring (0-100%) - Categorize queries: 'tdee-relevant' | 'general-fitness' | 'mixed' - Topic detection patterns - Response depth analysis

- Fix buildUserProfile() to conditionally include TDEE - Update buildTaskInstructionsWithQuestion() to remove forced TDEE - Add context-aware prompt building - Implement smart context injection based on relevance score
- Integrate contextAnalyzer into model selection - Optimize prompts based on query type - Add query-specific model routing
- Add QueryAnalysis type - Add ContextRelevance enum - Extend AIRequest with context analysis

deliverables.deliverable: Smart prompt templates per query category

scope.title: UI/UX Enhancements & Bug Fixes
scope.description: Fix overflow, duplication, and enhance card system

critical-issues.issue: Card text overflow - no CSS constraints

task.details: - Fix message state management (single source of truth) - Implement proper message deduplication logic - Add unique IDs to prevent duplicates - Fix viewMode switching without data loss
- Add max-height with overflow-y-auto to cards - Implement text truncation with "Show more" - Add responsive breakpoints - Ensure mobile compatibility
- Add expand/collapse functionality - Smooth animations with Tailwind - Preserve scroll position - Add visual indicators
- Smart truncation algorithm - Priority-based card ordering - Visual hierarchy improvements - Loading states per card

deliverables.deliverable: Cards properly constrained with scrollable content

scope.title: Enhanced Coaching System & Knowledge Domains
scope.description: Expand card types, create knowledge domains, personality engine

task.details: - Define 6 domains: training, nutrition, recovery, mindset, supplements, advanced - Create prompt templates per domain - Build topic recognition patterns - Add cross-domain linking
- Define personality profiles for each mode - Create response modifiers - Build consistency checker - Add tone calibration
- Add 12 new card types (insight, action, education, etc.) - Create card templates - Define priority logic - Add visual indicators per type
- Analyze responses for follow-up opportunities - Generate contextual suggestions - Rank by relevance - Personalize based on history
